_why: Skill-candidates row `a delta-self-review verb` (landed 2026-10-05): the delta review was dispatched by hand six times with an identical shape, and the report-naming constraint (a name OUTSIDE the audit filename grammar) was left to the caller's memory. h_mad_delta_stage.py validates everything before claiming anything (sha is a commit, the sha touched each phase doc, each --answers file is readable and non-empty; an unevaluable check halts), MINTS `<feature>.<phase>.delta-review.<sha7>-<UTC stamp>.md` with no override, refuses a minted name any IMPORTED ledger selector would read, claims report AND prompt path once with the assembler's machinery (releasing only this run's own claims on a refusal), and prints the Agent call. Each row breaks one of those properties.

mutations.name: name-has-no-timestamp
mutations._mechanism: Two stagings of one sha mint ONE name, so the second is refused as handed instead of staged fresh.

mutations.name: name-has-no-sha
mutations._mechanism: The name no longer says which revision was reviewed.

mutations.name: version-selector-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A `.vN.md` name, which h_mad_cycle_counts counts as an audit cycle, is staged.

mutations.name: version-selector-copied
mutations._mechanism: A frozen copy of _VERSION_RE stops tracking the ledger's grammar when it widens.

mutations.name: stamp-selector-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The gate-stamp grammar is no longer consulted, so a stamp grammar that widens is not followed.

mutations.name: audit-segment-check-dropped
mutations._mechanism: A name carrying `.audit.`, which the ledger globs select on, is staged.

mutations.name: grammar-check-bypassed
mutations._mechanism: The minted name is never checked against the ledger grammar.

mutations.name: commit-type-unchecked
mutations._mechanism: A sha naming a tree (or blob, or tag) is accepted as the reviewed revision.

mutations.name: unresolvable-sha-misreported
mutations._mechanism: A sha git cannot resolve is reported under the wrong reason rather than unresolvable.

mutations.name: unchanged-doc-accepted
mutations._mechanism: A sha that did not touch the doc stages a review of nothing.
mutations.find: return None if show.stdout.strip() else "unchanged"  # M:DSTAGE-UNCHANGED

mutations.name: show-error-is-not-named
mutations._mechanism: A git failure on `show` is not reported as git_error: an evaluation failure reads as a verdict about the doc.

mutations.name: missing-answers-accepted
mutations._mechanism: A --answers path that does not exist is staged into the prompt.

mutations.name: empty-answers-accepted
mutations._mechanism: An empty --answers file is staged as the findings the revision answers.
mutations.find: return None if head else "empty"  # M:DSTAGE-ANSWERS-EMPTY

mutations.name: unreadable-answers-pass
mutations._mechanism: A --answers file that cannot be read takes the passed branch: fail-open on an unevaluated check.

mutations.name: answers-optional
mutations._mechanism: With no --answers the review has no findings to scope it, and is staged anyway.

mutations.name: duplicate-phase-accepted
mutations._mechanism: `--phase plan --phase plan` mints one name twice and is reported as a handed path instead of a usage error.

mutations.name: existing-report-path-staged
mutations._mechanism: A report path that already exists (a live leg's) is claimed and handed.
mutations.find: held = next((p for p in (report, prompt) if aa._present(p)), None)  # M:DSTAGE-FRESH

mutations.name: existing-prompt-path-unchecked
mutations._mechanism: Only the report path is measured, so a live leg's prompt path is found only at the write.
mutations.find: held = next((p for p in (report, prompt) if aa._present(p)), None)  # M:DSTAGE-FRESH
mutations.replace: held = next((p for p in (report,) if aa._present(p)), None)  # M:DSTAGE-FRESH

mutations.name: mint-halts-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A refused mint (grammar or freshness) is dropped from the run, which then exits as if staged.

mutations.name: claim-result-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A report path claimed by an earlier leg is handed again: the #49o clobber.

mutations.name: prompt-path-not-claimed
mutations._mechanism: Only the report path is claimed, so a prompt path handed to another leg is reused.

mutations.name: refused-claim-keeps-this-runs-claims
mutations._mechanism: A later phase's refused claim leaves the earlier phases' fresh claims behind, burning paths for legs never dispatched.

mutations.name: spec-resolved-beside-design
mutations._mechanism: doc_path, shared with the assembler, puts the spec under the design directory.
mutations.find: base = design_dir if kind == "design" else docs_dir
mutations.replace: base = design_dir if kind in ("design", "spec") else docs_dir

mutations.name: unchanged-judged-on-a-pathspec
mutations._mechanism: The doc path goes to `git show` as a pathspec, so a glob in it matches a changed sibling and an untouched doc reads as changed.

mutations.name: feature-grammar-reverted
mutations._mechanism: Only `/` is refused, so a newline, quote, space or glob in --feature reaches the prompt, the Agent call and the pathspec.
mutations.replace: if not args.feature or "/" in args.feature:  # M:DSTAGE-FEATURE

mutations.name: feature-grammar-prefix-only
mutations._mechanism: A prefix match accepts any name that merely STARTS well-formed.

mutations.name: encode-error-escapes-rollback
mutations._mechanism: A UnicodeEncodeError (non-UTF-8 path) is not an OSError: it escapes as a traceback, leaving claims and a partial prompt.

mutations.name: written-prompts-kept-on-write-failure
mutations._mechanism: A later phase's write failure leaves the earlier phases' prompt files behind for legs never dispatched.

mutations.name: claims-kept-on-write-failure
mutations._mechanism: A write failure leaves every claim this run made, burning the paths.

mutations.name: write-failure-footer-says-nothing-written
mutations._mechanism: The write-failure HALT says nothing was written, after it wrote and removed files.
mutations.find: footer="this run's prompt files and claims were removed; "
mutations.replace: footer="nothing was claimed and nothing was written. "

mutations.name: claims-kept-on-marker-failure
mutations._mechanism: A claim that cannot be written leaves the claims this run already made.

mutations.name: answers-kind-unchecked
mutations._mechanism: A FIFO --answers passes open() and blocks the read forever instead of halting.

mutations.name: sha-is-one-commit-undocumented
mutations._mechanism: SKILL.md no longer says --sha is one commit, so a two-commit revision is staged and half-reviewed.
mutations.find: **`--sha` is ONE commit, and the review sees only that commit.**

mutations.name: control-chars-never-detected
mutations._mechanism: No value is ever found to carry a control character, so a newline in --answers writes a second REPORT= into the prompt.
mutations.replace: return False and any(unicodedata.category(c) in _CONTROL_CATEGORIES  # M:DSTAGE-CONTROL

mutations.name: control-class-is-only-newline
mutations._mechanism: Only `\n` is refused, so a CR, ESC, tab or U+2028 still reaches the prompt.

mutations.name: answers-not-checked-for-control
mutations._mechanism: --answers paths, the value the round-2 review injected through, are left out of the check.
mutations.find: + [("answers", a) for a in args.answers])  # M:DSTAGE-CONTROL-ARGS

mutations.name: control-halt-ignored
mutations._mechanism: Tainted values are found and then staged anyway.

mutations.name: minted-paths-not-checked-for-control
mutations._mechanism: A minted report or prompt path carrying a control character is staged into the prompt.
